Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded in Step 6 that the birthplace was "Gorky (now Nizhny Novgorod)" based on a misinterpretation of the Wikipedia text visible in the viewport. The text actually stated: "Nemtsov was raised in Gorky, now Nizhny Novgorod." The Planner confused the city where he was *raised* with the city where he was *born*. This error led to a persistent incorrect conclusion despite subsequent instructions to verify the "Born" line, which would have shown Sochi.
